_note: Label-free, DEPLOYABLE cells computed from the image itself: k-means (k = 16, fixed seed) on a 32-bin intensity histogram of the 512-resized grey image + log(native width x height), fitted on the SSL pool and cached under outputs/cache/. The closest honest substitute for a per-image acquisition condition; its class leak is measured by cell_report.py. Every other value is DINO_SARDet/config_ssl.json; shared keys (epochs, batch, views) live in shared/ssl_common.json and may not appear here.

optim._lr_note: reference rate for a batch of 256; the rate used is lr * batch_size / 256 (linear scaling, as in main_dino.py)

cond_center.label_use: none (pixels and native image size only)
cond_center._note: cells: source_pol | perm | oracle_class | radiometric (cells.py). label_use must state the truth for the variant (train_ssl.py refuses otherwise). permute_seed is used by perm only. center_momentum_cell = EMA momentum of each cell center (the global center keeps dino.center_momentum and is tracked but never subtracted).
